integrity.novelty_scope: all skew zero-forcing sets, their cardinality enumerator, and the exact one-coefficient difference from ordinary zero forcing

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to crown graphs \(K_{n,n}-M_n\) with \(n\ge3\) and the standard skew color-change rule.

The minimum skew zero-forcing number alone may be implied by earlier matching or minimum-skew-rank theory; originality is based on the all-set criterion, complete enumerator, and exact ordinary-versus-skew defect.

The 2010 foundational skew-rank paper is bibliographically relevant, but no exact earlier public-posting day was used in the date field; the exact public v1 date 2014-04-06 of the directly inspected skew-zero-forcing source anchors first_public_date.
Nonindexed theses or specialized tables remain a residual originality risk.
title: Skew zero-forcing enumerator of crown graphs
